evidence: Independent source review of the Mac updater backend after the feature rebase and background-task idle fix keeps build 1 compatible. New Mac recovery routes require executor ingress and do not change native routes. Native APIClient uses unchanged /api/deployment-status and payload-free SSE contracts, not additive /api/updates Mac fields. Exact Mac termination uses the existing interrupted conversation ending and unchanged view/tail serializers. The command fence changes only Mac dispatch authority and existing uncertain outcomes. The idle fix counts existing session background-task facts; it adds no wire fields, event kinds, or native response shapes. Native Swift, build-floor policy, draft storage, and outbox behavior remain unchanged. The earlier 14 guarded build-gate unit cases and one real-app integration case remain applicable to unchanged native middleware and prove supported reads/action and unsupported read/write/SSE rejection before side effects. Independent review also passed four focused background-task idle cases. Parent verification passed source mypy on 671 files and the protocol 20/outbox 5 schema guard after this idle fix. Unsigned or signed device execution, live ingress/reconnect, and TestFlight readiness remain untested owner checks.
